crossRefs.note: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country…
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.
For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her…

parallels.note: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country…

people.name: Arabia
people.line: A region and its inhabitants, mentioned in various contexts.

translations.web: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.
translations.bsb: not including the revenue from the merchants, traders, and all the Arabian kings and governors of the land.
translations.kjv: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
translations.asv: besides that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mingled people, and of the governors of the country.
